title: 深水埗遮王威哥
titleJyutping: sam1 seoi2 bou2 ze1 wong4 wai1 go1
titleEnglish: Umbrella King Wai of Sham Shui Po

sentences.cantonese: 有個喺深水埗賣遮嘅先生，叫威哥。
sentences.jyutping: jau5 go3 hai2 sam1 seoi2 bou2 maai6 ze1 ge3 sin1 saang1, giu3 wai1 go1.
sentences.english: There was an umbrella seller in Sham Shui Po, called Wai Gor.

sentences.cantonese: 佢做生意嘅手法，今時今日都好神奇。
sentences.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 saang1 ji3 ge3 sau2 faat3, gam1 si4 gam1 jat6 dou1 hou2 san4 kei4.
sentences.english: His business methods are astonishing even today.

sentences.cantonese: 我唔知佢幾歲，應該有六十幾七十。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 m4 zi1 keoi5 gei2 seoi3, jing1 goi1 jau5 luk6 sap6 gei2 cat1 sap6.
sentences.english: I don't know his age, probably around sixty or seventy.

sentences.cantonese: 佢一臉白鬚，著住短袖恤衫同西褲。
sentences.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 lim6 baak6 sou1, zoek3 zyu6 dyun2 zau6 seot1 saam1 tung4 sai1 fu3.
sentences.english: He had a white beard, wore a short-sleeved shirt and slacks.

sentences.cantonese: 佢把聲好大，雙眼精光。
sentences.jyutping: keoi5 baa2 seng1 hou2 daai6, soeng1 ngaan5 zing1 gwong1.
sentences.english: His voice was loud, and his eyes were bright.

sentences.cantonese: 佢話祖先喺香港割讓比英國時開始賣遮。
sentences.jyutping: keoi5 waa6 zou2 sin1 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 got3 joeng6 bei2 jing1 gwok3 si4 hoi1 ci2 maai6 ze1.
sentences.english: He said his ancestors started selling umbrellas when Hong Kong was ceded to the British.

sentences.cantonese: 唔係大企業，但已經做咗二百幾年。
sentences.jyutping: m4 hai6 daai6 kei5 jip6, daan6 ji5 ging1 zou6 zo2 ji6 baak3 gei2 nin4.
sentences.english: It’s not a big company, but has been running for over 200 years.

sentences.cantonese: 港交所有冧把未？佢完全唔理。
sentences.jyutping: gong2 gaau1 so2 jau5 lam1 baa2 mei6? keoi5 jyun4 cyun4 m4 lei5.
sentences.english: Does the stock exchange fluctuate? He doesn’t care at all.

sentences.cantonese: 佢滿足於自己間小店嘅天地。
sentences.jyutping: keoi5 mun5 zuk1 jyu1 zi6 gei2 gaan1 siu2 dim3 ge3 tin1 dei6.
sentences.english: He's content with the world inside his small shop.

sentences.cantonese: 佢更有興趣教人點開遮、收遮。
sentences.jyutping: keoi5 gang3 jau5 hing3 ceoi3 gaau3 jan4 dim2 hoi1 ze1, sau1 ze1.
sentences.english: He's more interested in teaching people how to open and close umbrellas.

sentences.cantonese: 佢仲會教人點摺遮，多過賣遮。
sentences.jyutping: keoi5 zung6 wui5 gaau3 jan4 dim2 zip3 ze1, do1 gwo3 maai6 ze1.
sentences.english: He even teaches how to fold umbrellas, more than actually selling them.

sentences.cantonese: 有人拎遮俾佢修理，佢一概收。
sentences.jyutping: jau5 jan4 ling1 ze1 bei2 keoi5 sau1 lei5, keoi5 jat1 koi3 sau1.
sentences.english: If someone brings an umbrella for repair, he accepts them all.

sentences.cantonese: 但因為得佢一個人做，已經積咗千幾把遮。
sentences.jyutping: daan6 jan1 wai6 dak1 keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 zou6, ji5 ging1 zik1 zo2 cin1 gei2 baa2 ze1.
sentences.english: But since he works alone, he has a backlog of over a thousand umbrellas.

sentences.cantonese: 佢話死之前都整唔晒添喎。
sentences.jyutping: keoi5 waa6 sei2 zi1 cin4 dou1 zing2 m4 saai3 tim1 wo5.
sentences.english: He said he probably can't finish fixing them all before he dies.

title: 午後陽光與蚊的戰爭
titleJyutping: ng5 ng6 joeng4 gwong1 jyu5 man1 dik1 zin3 zang1
titleEnglish: Afternoon Sunlight and the War with Mosquitoes

sentences.cantonese: 我會望見午後嘅陽光，灑落喺露台邊。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 wui5 mong6 gin3 ng5 hau6 ge3 joeng4 gwong1, saa2 lok6 hai2 lou6 toi4 bin1.
sentences.english: I see afternoon sunlight pouring by the balcony.

sentences.cantonese: 光線會入屋，角度同範圍啱啱好。
sentences.jyutping: gwong1 sin3 wui5 jap6 uk1, gok3 dou6 tung4 faan6 wai4 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2.
sentences.english: The sunlight enters the room at just the right angle and range.

sentences.cantonese: 唔會曬到梳化上慵懶嘅我。
sentences.jyutping: m4 wui5 saai3 dou2 so1 faa2 soeng6 jung4 laan5 ge3 ngo5.
sentences.english: It doesn’t shine on the lazy me lying on the sofa.

sentences.cantonese: 我會望見窗紗外，蚊喺度搵機會衝入嚟。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 wui5 mong6 gin3 coeng1 saa1 ngoi6, man1 hai2 dou6 wan2 gei1 wui6 cung1 jap6 lai4.
sentences.english: I see mosquitoes outside the screen window trying to sneak in.

sentences.cantonese: 有時會有蚊唔覺意跟我入屋。
sentences.jyutping: jau5 si4 wui5 jau5 man1 m4 gok3 ji3 gan1 ngo5 jap6 uk1.
sentences.english: Sometimes mosquitoes accidentally follow me indoors.

sentences.cantonese: 唔知佢哋入咗屋係幸定不幸。
sentences.jyutping: m4 zi1 keoi5 dei6 jap6 zo2 uk1 hai6 hang6 ding6 bat1 hang6.
sentences.english: Not sure if entering the house is lucky or unlucky for them.

sentences.cantonese: 佢哋可能吸到血，食飽飽。
sentences.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 ho2 nang4 kap1 dou2 hyut3, sik6 baau2 baau2.
sentences.english: They might get to feed on my blood and feel full.

sentences.cantonese: 但入得嚟嘅蚊九成都死硬。
sentences.jyutping: daan6 jap6 dak1 lai4 ge3 man1 gau2 sing4 dou1 sei2 ngaang6.
sentences.english: But ninety percent of them die after coming in.

sentences.cantonese: 我唔用電蚊拍，怕電親自己。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 m4 jung6 din6 man1 paak3, paa3 din6 can1 zi6 gei2.
sentences.english: I don’t use electric swatters for fear of shocking myself.

sentences.cantonese: 我盡量唔用雙手拍蚊，因為好痛。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 zeon6 loeng6 m4 jung6 soeng1 sau2 paak3 man1, jan1 wai6 hou2 tung3.
sentences.english: I try not to swat them with both hands because it hurts.

sentences.cantonese: 而且成日都拍唔中。
sentences.jyutping: ji4 ce2 seng4 jat6 dou1 paak3 m4 zung3.
sentences.english: And I often miss anyway.

sentences.cantonese: 我會揮掌打暈佢哋，再擊落地。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 wui5 fai1 zoeng2 daa2 wan4 keoi5 dei6, zoi3 gik1 lok6 dei6.
sentences.english: I would wave my palm to stun them, then knock them to the ground.

sentences.cantonese: 我用紙執起暈咗嘅蚊，輕輕摙死佢。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 zi2 zap1 hei2 wan4 zo2 ge3 man1, heng1 heng1 lin2 sei2 keoi5.
sentences.english: I gently pick up the fainted mosquito with tissue and softly kill it.

sentences.cantonese: 將死無全屍嘅佢送入垃圾桶。
sentences.jyutping: zoeng1 sei2 mou4 cyun4 si1 ge3 keoi5 sung3 jap6 laap6 saap3 tung2.
sentences.english: Then I toss its mutilated body into the trash.

sentences.cantonese: 試過一日送走五隻蚊歸西。
sentences.jyutping: si3 gwo3 jat1 jat6 sung3 zau2 ng5 zek3 man1 gwai1 sai1.
sentences.english: One day I sent five mosquitoes to the other world.

sentences.cantonese: 但我手上一滴血都無染到。
sentences.jyutping: daan6 ngo5 sau2 soeng6 jat1 dik6 hyut3 dou1 mou5 jim5 dou2.
sentences.english: But not a single drop of blood stained my hand.

title: 小店的人情味
titleJyutping: siu2 dim3 dik1 jan4 cing4 mei6
titleEnglish: The Warmth of Small Shops

sentences.cantonese: 「小店」散發住值得推崇嘅人情味。
sentences.jyutping: siu2 dim3 saan3 faat3 zyu6 zik6 dak1 teoi1 sung4 ge3 jan4 cing4 mei6.
sentences.english: Small shops radiate a kind of praiseworthy human warmth.

sentences.cantonese: 呢啲人情味唔止喺佢對你好嗰陣發生。
sentences.jyutping: ni1 di1 jan4 cing4 mei6 m4 zi2 hai2 keoi5 deoi3 nei5 hou2 go2 zan6 faat3 sang1.
sentences.english: That warmth isn’t only shown when they treat you well.

sentences.cantonese: 有一次，我喺錦田一間細麵舖食早餐。
sentences.jyutping: jau5 jat1 ci3, ngo5 hai2 gam2 tin4 jat1 gaan1 sai3 min6 pou3 sik6 zou2 caan1.
sentences.english: One time, I had breakfast at a small noodle shop in Kam Tin.

sentences.cantonese: 嗰間舖頭新開，好多嘢未上軌道。
sentences.jyutping: go2 gaan1 pou3 tau2 san1 hoi1, hou2 do1 je5 mei6 soeng5 gwai2 dou6.
sentences.english: The shop was newly opened and not yet running smoothly.

sentences.cantonese: 我同朋友去過幾次，都習慣咗要等。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 pang4 jau5 heoi3 gwo3 gei2 ci3, dou1 zaap6 gwaan3 zo2 jiu3 dang2.
sentences.english: My friend and I had been there a few times and got used to waiting.

sentences.cantonese: 亦習慣咗佢哋流程上有啲亂。
sentences.jyutping: jik6 zaap6 gwaan3 zo2 keoi5 dei6 lau4 cing4 soeng6 jau5 di1 lyun6.
sentences.english: We also got used to their workflow being a bit messy.

sentences.cantonese: 嗰朝我一個人去到，老闆娘忙到踢晒腳。
sentences.jyutping: go2 ziu1 ngo5 jat1 go3 jan4 heoi3 dou3, lou5 baan2 noeng4 mong4 dou3 tek3 saai3 goek3.
sentences.english: That morning I went alone and saw the boss lady rushing around.

sentences.cantonese: 我就自己搵個位坐低，諗住等佢忙完先落單。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 zau6 zi6 gei2 wan2 go3 wai2 co5 dai1, nam2 zyu6 dang2 keoi5 mong4 jyun4 sin1 lok6 daan1.
sentences.english: So I sat myself down and planned to order after she was free.

sentences.cantonese: 點知對面有兩個女人問我食咩。
sentences.jyutping: dim2 zi1 deoi3 min6 jau5 loeng5 go3 neoi5 jan2 man6 ngo5 sik6 me1.
sentences.english: Unexpectedly, two women opposite me asked what I wanted to eat.

sentences.cantonese: 佢哋幫我入去落咗單。
sentences.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 bong1 ngo5 jap6 heoi3 lok6 zo2 daan1.
sentences.english: They helped me place the order.

sentences.cantonese: 後來我先知，原來佢哋係街坊。
sentences.jyutping: hau6 loi4 ngo5 sin1 zi1, jyun4 loi4 keoi5 dei6 hai6 gaai1 fong1.
sentences.english: Later I learned that they were just neighborhood locals.

sentences.cantonese: 佢哋嚟得多，見到就幫手照顧人。
sentences.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 lai4 dak1 do1, gin3 dou2 zau6 bong1 sau2 ziu3 gu3 jan4.
sentences.english: They came often and just helped out whenever needed.

sentences.cantonese: 食緊飯時，隔離有個婆婆話啲湯太濃。
sentences.jyutping: sik6 gan2 faan6 si4, gaak3 lei4 jau5 go3 po4 po2 waa6 di1 tong1 taai3 nung4.
sentences.english: While eating, an elderly lady at the next table said the soup was too thick.

sentences.cantonese: 我同兩位街坊同阿婆三組人傾偈。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 loeng5 wai2 gaai1 fong1 tung4 aa3 po4 saam1 zou2 jan4 king1 gai2.
sentences.english: The two women, the old lady, and I, though strangers, started chatting.

sentences.cantonese: 我哋討論啲湯係點整出嚟嘅。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 tou2 leon6 di1 tong1 hai6 dim2 zing2 ceot1 lai4 ge3.
sentences.english: We discussed how the soup might have been made.

sentences.cantonese: 呢啲互動就係人情味。
sentences.jyutping: ni1 di1 wu6 dung6 zau6 hai6 jan4 cing4 mei6.
sentences.english: These kinds of interactions are what human warmth is all about.

title: 熟悉與陌生之間的音樂
titleJyutping: suk6 sik1 jyu5 mak6 sang1 zi1 gaan1 dik1 jam1 ngok6
titleEnglish: Music Between the Familiar and the Unknown

sentences.cantonese: 聽音樂要處於熟悉同陌生之間。
sentences.jyutping: teng1 jam1 ngok6 jiu3 cyu2 jyu1 suk6 sik1 tung4 mak6 sang1 zi1 gaan1.
sentences.english: To enjoy music, one must be between the familiar and the unfamiliar.

sentences.cantonese: 咁樣先會有趣味。
sentences.jyutping: gam2 joeng2 sin1 wui5 jau5 ceoi3 mei6.
sentences.english: That’s how it becomes interesting.

sentences.cantonese: 如果太熟悉，聽完上句已經知下句。
sentences.jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 taai3 suk6 sik1, teng1 jyun4 soeng6 geoi3 ji5 ging1 zi1 haa6 geoi3.
sentences.english: If it’s too familiar, you already know the next line after hearing the first.

sentences.cantonese: 聽完上段，就估到下段嘅樂器編排。
sentences.jyutping: teng1 jyun4 soeng6 dyun6, zau6 gu2 dou2 haa6 dyun6 ge3 ngok6 hei3 pin1 paai4.
sentences.english: After hearing one section, you can guess the instrument arrangement of the next.

sentences.cantonese: 咁樣都可以過下耳癮，但好快會厭。
sentences.jyutping: gam2 joeng2 dou1 ho2 ji5 gwo3 haa5 ji5 jan5, daan6 hou2 faai3 wui5 jim3.
sentences.english: That can satisfy your ears for a while, but you'll soon get bored.

sentences.cantonese: 呢啲歌我會叫做罐頭歌。
sentences.jyutping: ni1 di1 go1 ngo5 wui5 giu3 zou6 gun3 tau2 go1.
sentences.english: I call these songs 'canned music'.

sentences.cantonese: 但如果完全陌生，我會覺得係噪音。
sentences.jyutping: daan6 jyu4 gwo2 jyun4 cyun4 mak6 sang1, ngo5 wui5 gok3 dak1 hai6 cou3 jam1.
sentences.english: But if it’s totally unfamiliar, I consider it noise.

sentences.cantonese: 或者係一堆完全隨機嘅音符。
sentences.jyutping: waak6 ze2 hai6 jat1 deoi1 jyun4 cyun4 ceoi4 gei1 ge3 jam1 fu4.
sentences.english: Or just a bunch of completely random notes.

sentences.cantonese: 所謂「陌生」係完全估唔到、搵唔到規律。
sentences.jyutping: so2 wai6 'mak6 sang1' hai6 jyun4 cyun4 gu2 m4 dou2, wan2 m4 dou2 kwai1 leot6.
sentences.english: By 'unfamiliar', I mean you can’t predict or find any patterns.

sentences.cantonese: 大部分歌都喺兩極之間。
sentences.jyutping: daai6 bou6 fan6 go1 dou1 hai2 loeng5 gik6 zi1 gaan1.
sentences.english: Most songs exist somewhere between the two extremes.

sentences.cantonese: 流行曲接近罐頭歌嗰邊。
sentences.jyutping: lau4 hang4 kuk1 zip3 gan6 gun3 tau2 go1 go2 bin1.
sentences.english: Pop songs lean toward the canned music side.

sentences.cantonese: 佢哋揀咗「熟悉」一邊嚟發揮功效。
sentences.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 gaan2 zo2 'suk6 sik1' jat1 bin1 lai4 faat3 fai1 gung1 haau6.
sentences.english: They choose the 'familiar' side to achieve their effect.

sentences.cantonese: 流行曲令人口中易唱，易記。
sentences.jyutping: lau4 hang4 kuk1 ling6 jan4 hau2 zung1 ji6 coeng3, ji6 gei3.
sentences.english: Pop songs are easy to sing and remember.

sentences.cantonese: 因為佢規律簡單，特登等你估到。
sentences.jyutping: jan1 wai6 keoi5 kwai1 leot6 gaan2 daan1, dak6 dang1 dang2 nei5 gu2 dou2.
sentences.english: Because their structure is simple, on purpose, so you can guess what's next.

title: 戲院發展與電影業挑戰
titleJyutping: hei3 jyun2 faat3 zin2 jyu5 din6 jing2 jip6 tiu1 zin3
titleEnglish: Cinema Development and Challenges in the Film Industry

sentences.cantonese: 對比其他城市，我哋嘅情況又係點呢？
sentences.jyutping: deoi3 bei2 kei4 taa1 sing4 si5, ngo5 dei6 ge3 cing4 fong3 jau6 hai6 dim2 ne1?
sentences.english: Compared to other cities, how is our situation?

sentences.cantonese: 相比南韓同台北，我哋嘅人口比例偏低。
sentences.jyutping: soeng1 bei2 naam4 hon4 tung4 toi4 bak1, ngo5 dei6 ge3 jan4 hau2 bei2 lai6 pin1 dai1.
sentences.english: Compared to South Korea and Taipei, our population ratio is low.

sentences.cantonese: 只係高過胡志明市同雅加達啲地區。
sentences.jyutping: zi2 hai6 gou1 gwo3 wu4 zi3 ming4 si5 tung4 ngaa5 gaa1 daat6 di1 dei6 keoi1.
sentences.english: Only higher than developing areas like Ho Chi Minh City and Jakarta.

sentences.cantonese: 從戲院商會嘅難題可以見到問題。
sentences.jyutping: cung4 hei3 jyun2 soeng1 wui2 ge3 naan4 tai4 ho2 ji5 gin3 dou2 man6 tai4.
sentences.english: We can see problems from the cinema association's difficulties.

sentences.cantonese: 扶助電影業要喺多方面落工夫。
sentences.jyutping: fu4 zo6 din6 jing2 jip6 jiu3 hai2 do1 fong1 min6 lok6 gung1 fu1.
sentences.english: Supporting the film industry requires effort in many areas.

sentences.cantonese: 唔單止要培訓人才，仲要增建設施。
sentences.jyutping: m4 daan1 zi2 jiu3 pui4 fan3 jan4 coi4, zung6 jiu3 zang1 gin3 cit3 si1.
sentences.english: Not only do we need talent training, but also more facilities.

sentences.cantonese: 俾香港人成為電影欣賞者或者消費者。
sentences.jyutping: bei2 hoeng1 gong2 jan4 sing4 wai4 din6 jing2 jan1 soeng2 ze2 waak6 ze2 siu1 fai3 ze2.
sentences.english: Let Hongkongers become film appreciators or consumers.

sentences.cantonese: 我認為增建戲院對社會和諧有好處。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 jing6 wai4 zang1 gin3 hei3 jyun2 deoi3 se5 wui2 wo4 haai4 jau5 hou2 cyu3.
sentences.english: I believe more cinemas benefit social harmony.

sentences.cantonese: 亦都有助家庭休閒同電影業發展。
sentences.jyutping: jik6 dou1 jau5 zo6 gaa1 ting4 jau1 haan4 tung4 din6 jing2 jip6 faat3 zin2.
sentences.english: They also help family leisure and film industry growth.

sentences.cantonese: 因此，我希望藉住呢個機會提出問題。
sentences.jyutping: jan1 ci2, ngo5 hei1 mong6 zik6 zyu6 ni1 go3 gei1 wui6 tai4 ceot1 man6 tai4.
sentences.english: Therefore, I hope to raise issues through this opportunity.

sentences.cantonese: 戲院商會代表電影業下游提出疑問。
sentences.jyutping: hei3 jyun2 soeng1 wui2 doi6 biu2 din6 jing2 jip6 haa6 jau4 tai4 ceot1 ji4 man6.
sentences.english: The cinema association raised questions for the downstream sector.

sentences.cantonese: 我希望當局可以清楚答覆佢哋。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 hei1 mong6 dong1 guk6 ho2 ji5 cing1 co2 daap3 fuk1 keoi5 dei6.
sentences.english: I hope the authorities can respond to them clearly.

sentences.cantonese: 講清楚政府會點樣支持戲院發展。
sentences.jyutping: gong2 cing1 co2 zing3 fu2 wui5 dim2 joeng2 zi1 ci4 hei3 jyun2 faat3 zin2.
sentences.english: Explain clearly how the government will support cinema development.

title: 香港產業政策與國際競爭力
titleJyutping: hoeng1 gong2 caan2 jip6 zing3 caak3 jyu5 gwok3 zai3 ging3 zang1 lik6
titleEnglish: Hong Kong's Industrial Policy and Global Competitiveness

sentences.cantonese: 主席，我今日聽到好多位議員發言。
sentences.jyutping: zyu2 zik6, ngo5 gam1 jat6 teng1 dou2 hou2 do1 wai2 ji5 jyun4 faat3 jin4.
sentences.english: Chairman, I heard many legislators speak today.

sentences.cantonese: 佢哋對香港產業政策提出好多意見。
sentences.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 deoi3 hoeng1 gong2 caan2 jip6 zing3 caak3 tai4 ceot1 hou2 do1 ji3 gin3.
sentences.english: They shared many views on Hong Kong's industrial policies.

sentences.cantonese: 亦有議員認為我哋有好多地方做得唔夠。
sentences.jyutping: jik6 jau5 ji5 jyun4 jing6 wai4 ngo5 dei6 jau5 hou2 do1 dei6 fong1 zou6 dak1 m4 gau3.
sentences.english: Some believe we haven’t done enough in many areas.

sentences.cantonese: 當然，我哋唔應該對產業政策自滿。

title: 科學方法與學科分類
titleJyutping: fo1 hok6 fong1 faat3 jyu5 hok6 fo1 fan1 leoi6
titleEnglish: Scientific Method and Classification of Disciplines

sentences.cantonese: 科學係有系統噉去尋求知識。
sentences.jyutping: fo1 hok6 hai6 jau5 hai6 tung2 gam2 heoi3 cam4 kau4 zi1 sik1.
sentences.english: Science is a systematic way to seek knowledge.

sentences.cantonese: 佢會組織知識，變成一個行業。
sentences.jyutping: keoi5 wui5 zou2 zik1 zi1 sik1, bin3 sing4 jat1 go3 hong4 jip6.
sentences.english: It organizes knowledge into a discipline.

sentences.cantonese: 科學係建立喺實證方法上。
sentences.jyutping: fo1 hok6 hai6 gin3 laap6 hai2 sat6 zing3 fong1 faat3 soeng6.
sentences.english: Science is based on empirical methods.

sentences.cantonese: 科學家會提出可驗證嘅理論。
sentences.jyutping: fo1 hok6 gaa1 wui5 tai4 ceot1 ho2 jim6 zing3 ge3 lei5 leon6.
sentences.english: Scientists propose theories that can be tested.

sentences.cantonese: 佢哋會做實驗，或者觀察。
sentences.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 wui5 zou6 sat6 jim6, waak6 ze2 gun1 caat3.
sentences.english: They conduct experiments or observations.

sentences.cantonese: 透過收集數據驗證理論。
sentences.jyutping: tau3 gwo3 sau1 zaap6 sou3 geoi3 jim6 zing3 lei5 leon6.
sentences.english: They collect data to validate theories.

sentences.cantonese: 如果數據唔符合，理論會被淘汰。
sentences.jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 sou3 geoi3 m4 fu4 hap6, lei5 leon6 wui5 bei6 tou4 taai3.
sentences.english: If the data doesn’t fit, the theory is rejected.

sentences.cantonese: 有啲理論會被修改再驗證。
sentences.jyutping: jau5 di1 lei5 leon6 wui5 bei6 sau1 goi2 zoi3 jim6 zing3.
sentences.english: Some theories are revised and re-tested.

sentences.cantonese: 科學係咁樣重複呢個過程。
sentences.jyutping: fo1 hok6 hai6 gam2 joeng6 cung4 fuk1 ni1 go3 gwo3 cing4.
sentences.english: Science repeats this process again and again.

sentences.cantonese: 直至理論完全符合數據。
sentences.jyutping: zik6 zi3 lei5 leon6 jyun4 cyun4 fu4 hap6 sou3 geoi3.
sentences.english: Until the theory fully matches the data.

sentences.cantonese: 現代科學按研究題目分類。
sentences.jyutping: jin6 doi6 fo1 hok6 on3 jin4 gau3 tai4 muk6 fan1 leoi6.
sentences.english: Modern science is classified by research topics.

sentences.cantonese: 大類有形式、物理、生命同社會科學。
sentences.jyutping: daai6 leoi6 jau5 jing4 sik1, mat6 lei5, sang1 ming6 tung4 se5 wui2 fo1 hok6.
sentences.english: Major branches include formal, physical, life, and social sciences.

sentences.cantonese: 每類科學可以再細分。

sentences.cantonese: 例如物理科學研究無生命物體。
sentences.jyutping: lai6 jyu4 mat6 lei5 fo1 hok6 jin4 gau3 mou4 sang1 ming6 mat6 tai2.
sentences.english: For example, physical science studies non-living things.

sentences.cantonese: 可以再細分做物理同化學。
sentences.jyutping: ho2 ji5 zoi3 sai3 fan1 zou6 mat6 lei5 tung4 faa3 hok6.
sentences.english: It can be further split into physics and chemistry.

title: 肚餓聲音的科學原因

sentences.english: It can be quite awkward when the environment is quiet.

sentences.english: Have you ever wondered where the sound comes from?

sentences.jyutping: kei4 sat6 ping4 si4 m4 tou5 ngo6 dou1 wui5 jau5 seng1.
sentences.english: Actually, you can hear it even when you're not hungry.

sentences.english: It's just quieter when your stomach is full.

sentences.cantonese: 因為食物喺胃入面吸收咗聲。
sentences.jyutping: jan1 wai6 sik6 mat6 hai2 wai6 jap6 min6 kap1 sau1 zo2 seng1.
sentences.english: Food inside the stomach muffles the sound.

sentences.cantonese: 胃收縮係有周期性出現。
sentences.jyutping: wai6 sau1 suk1 hai6 jau5 zau1 kei4 sing3 ceot1 jin4.
sentences.english: Stomach contractions occur cyclically.

sentences.cantonese: 大約半個鐘就會一次。
sentences.jyutping: daai6 joek3 bun3 go3 zung1 zau6 wui5 jat1 ci3.
sentences.english: It happens roughly every half an hour.

titleJyutping: man1 jyu5 ng5 hau6 dik1 zing6 mat6 si4 gwong1
titleEnglish: Mosquitoes and the Quiet Afternoon Light

sentences.cantonese: 我會望⾒午後嘅陽光灑落喺露台邊。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 wui5 mong6gin3 ng5hau6 ge3 joeng4gwong1 saa2lok6 hai2 lou6toi4 bin1.
sentences.english: I see the afternoon sunlight spilling over the balcony.

sentences.cantonese: 光線會⼊屋，⼊屋嘅⾓度同範圍剛剛好，
sentences.jyutping: gwong1sin3 wui5 jap6 uk1, jap6 uk1 ge3 gok3dou6 tung4 faan6wai4 gong1gong1 hou2,
sentences.english: The light enters the room at just the right angle and range,

sentences.cantonese: 唔會曬到梳化上慵懶嘅我。
sentences.jyutping: m4 wui5 saai3dou2 so1faa2 soeng6 jung4laan5 ge3 ngo5.
sentences.english: It doesn't shine directly on my lazily resting self on the sofa.

sentences.cantonese: 我會望⾒露台窗紗外揾緊機會衝⼊嚟嘅蚊，
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 wui5 mong6gin3 lou6toi4 coeng1saa1 ngoi6 wan2gan2 gei1wui6 cung1 jap6lai4 ge3 man1,
sentences.english: I see mosquitoes outside the window netting, looking for a chance to rush in.

sentences.cantonese: 有時會發現唔覺意跟咗我⼊屋嘅蚊。
sentences.jyutping: jau5si4 wui5 faat3jin6 m4gok3ji3 gan1zo2 ngo5 jap6 uk1 ge3 man1.
sentences.english: Sometimes I notice mosquitoes that sneak in unnoticed.

sentences.cantonese: 唔知佢哋⼊咗屋係幸定不幸。
sentences.jyutping: m4 zi1 keoi5dei6 jap6zo2 uk1 hai6 hang6 ding6 bat1hang6.
sentences.english: I’m not sure if entering the house is lucky or unlucky for them.

sentences.cantonese: 佢哋可能有機會吸到我嘅⾎，會⾷飽飽，
sentences.jyutping: keoi5dei6 ho2nang4 jau5 gei1wui6 kap1dou2 ngo5 ge3 hyut3, wui5 sik6baau2baau2,
sentences.english: They might get a chance to suck my blood and eat their fill,

sentences.cantonese: 但⼊得嚟嘅蚊九成係死路⼀條。
sentences.jyutping: daan6 jap6dak1lai4 ge3 man1 gau2sing4 hai6 sei2lou6jat1tiu4.
sentences.english: But nine out of ten mosquitoes that get in end up dead.

sentences.cantonese: 我唔⽤電蚊拍，因為怕⼿腳唔協調嘅我電親⾃⼰。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 m4 jung6 din6man1paak2, jan1wai6 paa3 sau2goek3 m4 hip3tiu4 ge3 ngo5 din6can1 zi6gei2.
sentences.english: I don’t use electric swatters for fear of shocking myself.

sentences.cantonese: 盡量唔會雙⼿拍蚊，因為會好痛，
sentences.jyutping: zeon6loeng6 m4 wui5 soeng1sau2 paak3 man1, jan1wai6 wui5 hou2 tung3,
sentences.english: I avoid clapping with both hands because it hurts.

sentences.cantonese: 同埋成⽇拍唔中。
sentences.jyutping: tung4maai4 seng4jat6 paak3m4zung3.
sentences.english: Also, I often miss.

sentences.cantonese: 我會揮掌將佢哋打暈，掌⼼向下噉將佢地擊落，
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 wui5 fai1zoeng2 zoeng1 keoi5dei6 daa2 wan4, zoeng2sam1 hoeng3 haa6 gam2 zoeng1 keoi5dei6 gik1lok6,
sentences.english: I swat them down with my palm facing down, trying to knock them out.

sentences.cantonese: 再拎張紙温柔噉執起暈咗嘅不速之客，
sentences.jyutping: zoi3 ling1 zoeng1 zi2 wan1jau4 gam2 zap1 hei2 wan4zo2 ge3 bat1cuk1zi1haak3,
sentences.english: Then gently pick up the unconscious uninvited guest with tissue.

sentences.cantonese: 輕輕摙死，將死無全屍嘅佢送⼊垃圾桶。
sentences.jyutping: heng6heng1 lin2 sei2, zoeng1 sei2mou4cyun4si1 ge3 keoi5 sung3 jap6 laap6saap3tung2.
sentences.english: Crush them softly and toss the broken body into the trash.

sentences.cantonese: 試過⼀⽇送咗五隻蚊歸西，
sentences.jyutping: si3gwo3 jat1 jat6 sung3zo2 ng5 zek3 man1 gwai1sai1,
sentences.english: One day I sent five mosquitoes to the west (killed them).

sentences.cantonese: ⽽我⼿上⼀滴⾎都冇沾染到。
sentences.jyutping: ji4 ngo5 sau2soeng6 jat1 dik6 hyut3 dou1 mou5 zim1jim5 dou2.
sentences.english: Yet not a drop of blood touched my hands.
